note: Source registry (config-as-truth, roadmap ingestion-plan.md M0). Every ingestion source is a row here, never hard-coded. `wired` = a fetcher exists in ingest/sources/ and the worker can run it today; the rest are declared-but-pending so the roadmap is legible in one place. `family`: catalog = structured route DB (area→crag→route tree); discovery = finds uncatalogued climbs (social/search), emits draft candidates.

sources.name: OpenBeta
sources.license: CC0-1.0 (data, public domain); AGPL-3.0 (their code, N/A to us)
sources.notes: First source — cleanest licence, keyless, live. US-only in practice (0/89 of our crags matched — it's ~US data). The CC0 bulk repo (github.com/OpenBeta/climbing-data) has the routes dump temporarily pulled + last pushed 2024-11, so we use the live API, not a clone. The clone's live-useful asset is per-US-state star ratings (enrichment), not the corpus.
sources.teaches: hierarchical areas, cascading gradeContext, all-systems grade object, composable disciplines, structured pitches

sources.name: theCrag
sources.license: ToS-restricted (public pages only, no login-walled data)
sources.tos: grey-area — rate-limit, cache, robots-respecting; scraped with Michel's permission, raw stays off the public site
sources.notes: ~1M routes, worldwide — the real path to non-US coverage. Cloudflare-fronted, needs browser_fetch. 154 rows already crawled once (2026-07-06). Port the old thecrag_client.py fetcher into ingest/sources/ off Postgres.
sources.teaches: grade context at any level, cascading tag-sets, 0-100 quality score -> editorial 0-3 stars

sources.name: UKClimbing
sources.tos: grey-area — rate-limit, cache, robots-respecting; scraped with Michel's permission, raw stays off the public site
sources.notes: ~150k routes, best UK/Ireland coverage + first-class access notes. 103 rows crawled once. KNOWN BUG: its scratch ukc-routes.json files were written into corpus/record/ and crash the store loader — the new module writes raw captures to ingest/.cache/ (gitignored), never the record.
sources.teaches: faceted crag search by rocktype/aspect/type, first-class access notes

sources.name: Mountain Project
sources.notes: No fetcher yet. grade-system auto-detection from leading chars (5.->YDS, V->V-scale, WI->ice, M->mixed) is worth adopting as a cheap deterministic pre-classifier.
sources.teaches: multi-discipline route type, grade-system leading-char detection

sources.name: SerpAPI social discovery
sources.license: SerpAPI ToS; results aggregated, no raw PII stored (GDPR)
sources.tos: query public Google results; keep place+route+timestamp, discard the person
sources.notes: Michel's idea: trad climbers post new lines to Instagram/Reddit/YouTube/forums, not always to route DBs. Query Google per region/crag with a recent-time filter (qdr:w / qdr:m) -> LLM extracts place+route mention -> draft CANDIDATE for curation. Reuses the SERPAPI_KEY plumbing already in engine/flights.py + fetch_chatter.py. Roadmap: social job #1 = discovery.
sources.teaches: uncatalogued lines; conditions/buzz signal (low-confidence, kept separate from the weather score)
